entry.title: Updated: dsh-voice-call
entry.summary: Agent-initiated voice calls: `offer_call` rings the human (接听/拒接/稍后再说); accepted calls synthesize and play locally via CrispASR + Qwen3-TTS (9 speakers, 2 Chinese dialects), rejected calls return the decision to the agent. Exact install spec: dsh-voice-call. Source event: zoahdev/dsh-subscribe; changed: sources.
